description: Stock management web app for Macroads. Replaces a hand-filled Excel workbook with yard-floor data entry, a live dashboard, and Excel as an export. Built as a Harness Engineering exercise: repo-as-system, leader/explorer/implementer/reviewer separation, spec-driven development.

features.name: repo_harness
features.title: Repository harness and spec foundation
features.description: Turn the directory into a system agents can work in: navigation map, docs, checkpoints, subagent definitions, progress log, verification entry point, and the two foundational specs.
acceptance: AC-1: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and CHECKPOINTS.md exist at the repository root
AC-2: docs/ contains architecture.md, conventions.md, verification.md and domain-glossary.md
AC-3: specs/ contains 000-product-brief.md and 001-domain-model.md, and 001 documents the workbook layout, the normalisation rules, the period model and the target schema
AC-4: .claude/agents/ contains leader.md, explorer.md, spec-writer.md, implementer.md and reviewer.md, each with valid YAML frontmatter
AC-6: init.ps1 and init.sh run to completion and print '[OK] Environment ready' with no application code present
AC-7: init verifies harness integrity: required files present, feature_list.json parses, every status and spec_status is valid, every spec_file referenced with spec_status != 'missing' exists on disk
AC-8: The repository is a git repository with an initial commit and a .gitignore covering node_modules, .env and build output
AC-9: Nothing under Samples/ has been modified
AC-10: Every question in specs/001-domain-model.md that blocks a feature before M7 is answered

features.name: app_scaffold
features.title: Next.js application scaffold
features.description: Next.js App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind, Prisma against a Dockerised Postgres, Vitest and Playwright wired up, all invoked from init.

features.name: auth_and_roles
features.title: Accounts and role-based access
features.description: Auth.js credentials provider, User model, COUNTER/MANAGER/ADMIN roles, route protection, seeded first admin.

features.name: domain_schema
features.title: Domain schema and first migration
features.description: Prisma schema per specs/001 Part 3: Location, Supplier, ItemType, Item, ItemPrice, ItemLocation, StockCount (keyed by location and period), StockCountLine (nullable quantity). Plus the migration and model-level tests.

features.name: seed_from_workbook
features.title: Seed the item master from the source workbook
features.description: Idempotent importer reading the Dublin and Clonmel sheets into Suppliers, ItemTypes, Items, ItemPrices and ItemLocation, applying the normalisation rules in specs/001 Part 2. Historical counts, the Summary sheet and the Trucks sheet are NOT imported. Emits an import report naming every item flagged needsReview.

features.name: item_master_ui
features.title: Item master administration
features.description: CRUD for items, suppliers and types; description required; versioned price lists; per-yard assignment and sheet ordering.

features.name: count_period_create
features.title: Start a stock count for a period
features.description: Create a count for a location and period. Period defaults from the count date (day <= 5 closes the previous month) and is overridable. Non-business-day dates warn but are allowed. One count per yard per month. Pre-populated with that yard's active items in sheet order, quantities null.

features.name: count_entry_ui
features.title: Count entry screen
features.description: Phone-first quantity entry with autosave. Distinguishes not-counted from counted-as-zero. Filter by type and supplier, running total, carry-forward from the previous period, and adding a one-off item inline.

features.name: count_submit
features.title: Submit and approve a count
features.description: DRAFT to SUBMITTED to APPROVED. Submission blocked while any line is uncounted. Price snapshot written on submit. Approved counts immutable. Variance-against-previous-period warnings.

features.name: dashboard_totals
features.title: Dashboard totals and variance
features.description: Per-yard totals by period, period completeness (no headline total until every yard has an approved count), month-on-month and year-on-year variance joined on period. Held items only.

features.name: dashboard_breakdown
features.title: Dashboard breakdowns
features.description: Value by type and by supplier, biggest movers since the previous period, per-item quantity trend.

features.name: export_yard_sheet
features.title: Excel export: yard sheets
features.description: Per-location sheet reproducing the Qty|Value column-pair layout with real headers and styling, generated from approved counts. Held items only by default, with a show-all option. No formula errors.

features.name: export_summary_sheet
features.title: Excel export: summary sheet
features.description: Per-yard totals, Total Stock, MoM and YoY by period. Incomplete periods are left visibly blank rather than filled with a partial total.

features.name: export_blank_count_sheet
features.title: Printable blank count sheet
features.description: A printable blank sheet listing all assigned items for a yard, as a paper fallback when the yard has no signal.

features.name: item_housekeeping
features.title: Dormant and incomplete item housekeeping
features.description: Items at zero across three or more consecutive counted periods are flagged for one-click archive by a MANAGER. Nothing is auto-archived; archiving never alters historical lines. The same screen lists items flagged needsReview, or missing unit or price.

features.name: deploy
features.title: Production deployment
features.description: Neon Postgres plus Vercel, environment configuration, migrate deploy in the pipeline, documented backup and restore.

features.name: trucks_schema_seed
features.title: Trucks and yard-bulk schema
features.description: Vehicle, BoilerReading, BagReading and YardBulkReading models, plus seeding of the truck registrations and role labels from the Clonmel Trucks and Yard sheet.
features.blocked_by_question: Q6 in specs/001-domain-model.md - does Dublin have its own trucks?

features.name: trucks_entry_ui
features.title: Truck and yard-bulk entry
features.description: Boiler percent-full and bag counts per truck, yard bulk bags, with kilogram rollups per material.
features.blocked_by_question: Q7 in specs/001-domain-model.md - do truck materials roll into the yard total?

features.name: export_trucks_sheet
features.title: Excel export: trucks and yard sheet
features.description: Trucks and yard sheet export, reproducing the boiler, bag and yard-bulk blocks.
